name: rain-api-observatory
description: RAIN API Observatory — API uptime and reliability monitoring

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @rain/shared" "npm run dev -w @rain/server" "npm run dev -w @rain/web"
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:worker -w @rain/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
